document.h: Curriculum Vitae – Front End Developer (Angular) – Healthcare / ML & LLM Integration Target

section.p: Front-end (Angular) and full-stack engineer – data-centric web applications, APIs, interoperability and AI/LLM integrations; motivated by healthcare impact.

Front-end developer with strong full-stack and integration background, used to delivering data-intensive web applications and API-first systems in cross-functional contexts (Product, UX/UI, engineering). Hands-on Angular in production (Angular 15); upgrade to Angular ≥16 identified and tracked in backlog (not yet executed). Proven experience integrating AI/LLM services via APIs to produce schema-constrained outputs and to operationalize data transformations, relevant to building server-side foundations for ML/LLM products in healthcare environments (interoperability, validation, traceability, performance).

li.p: API-based synchronization services between heterogeneous enterprise systems (e.g., CRM <-> ERP), with strong attention to data consistency, workflow orchestration, error handling, and incremental rollout in production contexts.

Derived from: enterprise integration work described across prior engagements, including API/ETL and system integration responsibilities (Cosmobilis, multi-client integration period, and related integration projects).

Integration of LLM services via APIs to transform unstructured or semi-structured inputs into structured outputs constrained by a data model (e.g., XML schema/XSD), including prompt design, orchestration, validation, and downstream integration into an enterprise CMS.

Derived from: “CMS-integrated CV retro-conversion and generation using Ballerina & OpenAI” (XML CMS demo, Ballerina orchestration, OpenAI API calls) and tchatapi-based prompt integration and testing workflows.

p.strong: Data-centric Platforms, XML Processing & Publication Pipelines

li.p: Design and delivery of data-centric platforms relying on structured data models, interoperability and XML processing, including validation, transformation, and publication/formatting chains.
Derived from: XML/HL7 interoperability and BaseX/XQuery workflows in healthcare contexts (HC Forum), XML CMS and publication pipelines, and integration-centric platform work.
Angular 15 (production); TypeScript; HTML; CSS. Upgrade path toward Angular ≥16 tracked in backlog (not yet executed).
UI integration with data-heavy back-ends; performance-conscious, maintainable component and feature delivery; collaboration with Product & UX/UI.
API-first architectures (REST, websocket event broadcasting); service integration and orchestration.
Ballerina services & jobs in production; PHP/Symfony; Python; ETL (Talend); relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL); Elasticsearch/Kibana.
OpenAI API integration for structured generation and transformation workflows (schema-constrained XML outputs), including prompt orchestration and system integration via APIs.
Agile/Scrum-inspired workflows; Jira/Confluence; GitHub CI/CD; Docker/AWS; operational ownership mindset.

p.strong: Senior Lead Developer & Architect – Internet & e-commerce platforms

li.p: 2023 – present
Migration and ongoing enhancement of a legacy high-traffic website; strong constraints on performance, data flows and operational robustness.
Front-end integration with Angular-based interfaces consuming data-heavy REST APIs; collaboration with Product and stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable implementation.
Built and operated integration components (Ballerina jobs/services) and event broadcasting (websocket) to support real-time user-facing workflows.
Technologies and tools: PHP/Symfony 2 & 6, Ballerina, Elasticsearch, REST APIs, websocket, MySQL, PostgreSQL, ETL (Talend), GitHub CI/CD, Docker/AWS.
Quality practices: Jira/Confluence; backlog-driven delivery with ownership and continuous improvement.

p.strong: Senior developer / architect – web platforms, integration and data-centric systems
CMS-integrated CV retro-conversion and generation using Ballerina & OpenAI

li.p: Implemented an end-to-end workflow to generate schema-constrained XML outputs from natural-language inputs, integrating OpenAI via API and orchestrating processing with Ballerina within an XML CMS context. Focus on data modelling constraints (XSD), validation, and robust integration for production-like usage.

p.strong: Enterprise integration service (EAI) – API-based synchronization of heavy data workflows

li.p: Designed and implemented API-driven synchronization between heterogeneous enterprise solutions (CRM & ERP) for complex business workflows (opportunities), using systematic API exploration, testing and partial integration through tchatapi-driven prompt and automation support. Emphasis on data consistency, workflow orchestration and incremental integration.
HC Forum / Open ENERGIE – Grenoble, France
Healthcare platform: patient record workflows, pedigrees and genetics-oriented modules, with interoperability constraints and XML-based message exchanges (HL7).
Implemented BaseX/XQuery components to manage HL7 XML interchange workflows between healthcare applications; collaborated closely with domain experts and cross-functional teams.
Agile team delivery (5–10 developers) with accountability for technical choices and end-to-end reliability.

Designed and implemented an API-focused product demonstrator to showcase integration scenarios and developer experience, including general-purpose prompt integration and structured output generation pipelines, relevant for ML/LLM product enablement and server-side integration consumed by modern front-end applications.
